done_when: forge ask "<question>" [--model <model>] runs one read-only Codex turn on the same app-server path builders use, waits for a place in the agent lane, prints the answer and records the run; the guide line matches the command; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade
why: The guide lists forge ask for asking Codex a question, but no such command exists, so advisor questions (for example to Astra) run outside Forge through a bare codex exec that skips the agent lanes, the pinned SDK and run records
